description_en: Enables the PROXY protocol. If the gateway ingress traffic is connected through NLB, the real IP address of the client cannot be obtained unless this feature is enabled. Enabling this feature does not affect non-PROXY protocol requests
description_zh: 开启Proxy协议。如果网关入口流量使用NLB接入，如果不开启则无法获取客户端的真实IP，开启后对于非Proxy协议请求没有影响
name: EnableProxyProtocol

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the feature of preserving the client source IP address by using the PROXY protocol. Valid values:

true: enables the feature of preserving the client source IP address.

false (default): disables the feature of preserving the client source IP address
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源IP功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能
parameters.name: enable_proxy_protocol

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The code used only to synchronize with the success status

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful

DynamicCode.description_en: The placeholder in the dynamic error message
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_en: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace %s in the error message of the ErrMessage response parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the passed request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的 %s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

Success.description_en:
The request result. Valid values:
`true`: The request is successful.
`false`: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
